key_insight: MDSKILL proposes multi-view distillation to help self-evolving agents internalize skill memories instead of relying only on textual guidance. The supplied abstract is truncated, so specific mechanisms and measured gains cannot be confirmed.
problem_solved: Self-generated skill memories can be noisy, redundant, or conflicting, making it difficult to turn past experience into reliable policy improvements through direct distillation.
method: Use textual skill memories to guide agent trajectories and complement reinforcement learning.
Apply on-policy self-distillation to provide dense, fine-grained supervision for learning from skill-guided behavior.
Introduce multi-view distillation to support skill internalization; implementation details are unavailable in the supplied excerpt.
impact: The approach aims to make experience-driven agent improvement more efficient by transferring useful skills into the policy itself. Its practical benefits and training-budget savings require verification from the full paper.
visual_elements: Learning-loop diagram: past experience → skill memory → guided trajectories → policy update.

Before-and-after schematic contrasting external skill prompts with internalized skills.
paper_title: MDSKILL: Learning to Internalize Skill Memory through Multi-View Distillation for Efficient Dynamic Agent Self-Evolution
paper_authors: Dian Jin, Jinluan Yang, Kairong Han, Baohong Li, Zijing Hu
